fields.description:
POC ALREADY BUILT in the sandbox by Kobi (2026-08-05). This card tracks validation and the work to productionise it.

Context: Joyce asked whether we can default a list view for reps. Salesforce cannot set a default list view per profile. The Home Page is the workaround — surface the records a rep needs to action so they never have to pick a list view.

Current POC layout (Wagertech Console home):

* Left column, tabbed: Sign-Ups by workload state — New / In Progress / Overdue.

* Middle column, tabbed: Accounts — All Players / Referrers.

* Right column, tabbed: Deal Rep Assignments — Assigned Deals / Other.

* Banner text at top explaining the page.

To validate with reps / Joyce:

* Are these the right three buckets, and is the tab order right?

* Do the visible fields match what a rep actually decides from (currently showing Operator, Time Since Sign Up, Status, Sign Up Id, Partner, Deposit, Payout Code, Proof Status, Completion)?

* Is "Overdue" defined the way reps expect?

Productionisation work if adopted:

* Remove Partner from the rep-facing version (BUILD-21) and reconcile visible fields with BUILD-42.

* Replace the placeholder "Deposit Date_old" field and any other legacy columns.

* Component list views must be admin-owned and locked once BUILD-111 lands.

* Assign the Lightning page as the Home Page for the Rep app/profile only; keep the Ops/Admin home separate.

* Confirm the list-view components respect the DRA-only visibility model (BUILD-64).

Related: BUILD-112 (Search Layouts — the other half of the "no default list view" answer), BUILD-37, BUILD-48.

Effort: \~2-4h to productionise after feedback.

Source: Kobi, 2026-08-05. Screenshot of the POC available from Kobi.
